page.title_zh: ADS42JB49 14位 250MSPS 模数转换器 JESD204B VQFN-64
page.meta_description_en: ADS42JB49 14-bit, 250-MSPS dual-channel ADC with JESD204B interface. Features 850mW/ch power dissipation, 100dB channel isolation, and 85fs aperture jitter. Ideal for communications and radar systems.
page.meta_description_zh: ADS42JB49 14位双通道模数转换器，采样率250MSPS，支持JESD204B接口。功耗850mW/通道，通道隔离度100dB，孔径抖动85fs，适用于通信与雷达系统。
